skill.summary: Self-orchestrating multi-agent development workflows. You say WHAT, the AI decides HOW.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of cc-godmode: a documentation-driven, multi-agent development orchestration system.

- Introduces structured multi-agent workflows for features, bug fixes, API changes, research, and releases.
- Documents roles, toolsets, and handoff paths for 8 specialized agents (e.g., researcher, builder, validator).
- Defines standard commands, workflow diagrams, and "10 Golden Rules" to guide usage and quality.
- Establishes dual quality gates (code & UX), reporting standards, and pre-push requirements.
- Includes detailed agent specifications, report file structures, and critical path enforcement for API changes.
